anchor.snippet: const filename = process.argv[index + 1], context = JSON.parse(await readFile(filename, 'utf8'));

entries.note: Capture the context once in the stable stdio facade. Replacement tool workers receive that exact snapshot through their private environment, so editing the context file or changing native focus cannot retarget an existing CLI. The worker performs root/session checks for every tool; this does not confine the CLI’s independent OS tools.

Serialize tool calls across worker replacement so a live request is never replayed. Prepare and list a candidate before swapping; failure keeps a working predecessor. A changed supervisor connector generation loads new tool code between requests and notifies tools/list_changed. A crashed tool worker is recreated on the next request. The original outer transport and CLI remain alive. A connector loaded before this facade cannot gain it retroactively; the bound runtime CLI is the authorized update fallback.
